rule: The lower bound of that interval against 0.90, the same bar round one used. Reading the lower bound, not the point estimate, is what makes a near miss a failure rather than a pass.
reading_rule: If the lower bound of the overall exact-agreement interval is below 0.90, two readers under annotation guide v3 are not shown to agree well enough for a reference to judge an extractor at the plan v2 precision bar. The project then either lowers the bar explicitly, with the new bar and its justification written down before any rescoring, or records protocol benchmarking as not a validated capability. There is no third round without a stated reason that is not "try again". If the lower bound reaches 0.90, a two-reader reference under guide v3 is adequate at that bar and an adjudicated annotation version may be built under its own plan.
